audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Scene-dependent background: a cool celadon-glaze porcelain inspection plate #E4E9E7 replaces the earlier warm #F0EEE6 swatch (background_policy is scene_dependent). Graphite #222522 linework, green #416B53 pointers and orange #E78636 active-digit marks keep their roles. Contrast: graphite 12.6:1, green text 4.95:1. Orange is used only for marks, never for text.

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json found no matching source frames (matchedSources 0) and STYLE.json lists no preview_recipes. No contact sheets existed to read, so the original engraving style is kept and no source observations are claimed.
Illustrative procedural 2D engraving, not a physical simulation. The gear mesh is shown by touching tick rims, and the carry tooth is a schematic carry mechanism.
The belt pulley is drawn on the same axle as the units wheel. Belt sag, slip and elasticity are not modelled.
The rail scale uses an arbitrary 4 px = 1 mm unit for the belt-travel readout.
The 5 px hatch pattern turns with the wheels, so it needs a moiré check at output size.
Fonts are local system faces (Georgia; Menlo / SF Mono / Courier New), so glyph metrics vary by host. No Blender or 3D tools were used.
